products.surfacePreparationNew: New plaster surface should be matured for the period of at least 6 months and moistened free. First apply Reliance Wall Care Putty and remove all the loose particles putty flakes using sand paper. Greater care should be taken for the top of the parapets and other horizontal surfaces where water is likely to amass during monsoon. Then, go for the paint application procedure.
products.surfacePreparationOld: Normally, every old plaster is painted with lime wash, cement paint or any previous paint. So, it must be scrapped thoroughly using sand paper or wire brush. Before painting repair, fill cracks, holes, leakage seepages, and drainage by using mixture of cement and sand in the ratio of 1:3 respectively. Use paint removal, especially for oil based paint applied earlier. Ensure that no efflorescence is present due to sodium, calcium, salt etc. on the surface.
